module: Node "World Editor Open" (repeat_instant). Indicates whether the world editor is open (editor.active). Input: reset (pulse). Outputs: open, close (flow), onOpened and onClosed (hidden pulses), openOrClosed (hidden bool).

C.desc: Flowgraph node class; each instance represents a node in a graph.

work.desc: Writes open/close/openOrClosed according to editor.active and emits an onOpened or onClosed pulse when the state changes compared to the previous frame.
